recognize_zh: 腦脊髓液細胞離心抹片中聚集一群大型異常單核細胞，核呈折疊、腎形或分葉狀，染色質細緻、可見核仁，細胞質灰藍並帶細小嗜天青顆粒，呈現骨髓單核球性芽細胞的特徵，符合 AML（急性骨髓單核球性白血病）於 CSF 復發。
features: Cluster of large atypical mononuclear cells with moderate to high N:C ratio
Nuclei folded, indented, reniform or lobulated (monocytoid)
Fine, open chromatin with visible nucleoli
Moderate gray-blue cytoplasm containing fine azurophilic granules in several cells
No Auer rods identified; clean proteinaceous background without inflammatory cells
describe_en: Cytocentrifuged cerebrospinal fluid shows a cellular specimen composed of a cluster of large atypical mononuclear cells. The cells have folded to lobulated monocytoid nuclei with fine chromatin and distinct nucleoli, and moderate gray-blue cytoplasm containing fine azurophilic granules. Mature lymphocytes and neutrophils are not a notable component, and Auer rods are not identified. Findings are consistent with central nervous system involvement by acute myeloid leukemia with myelomonocytic/monocytic differentiation; flow cytometry of the fluid is recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Reactive monocytes are fewer, have condensed chromatin without nucleoli and often vacuolated cytoplasm, rather than a cohesive population of immature cells with nucleoli.

ddx.dx: Traumatic tap with peripheral blood contamination
ddx.vs: Contamination brings red cells and a mixed PB leukocyte population, not a monomorphous population of blasts.

ddx.dx: CNS involvement by lymphoma or ALL
ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts or lymphoma cells lack azurophilic granules and monocytoid folded nuclei and show lymphoid immunophenotype by flow cytometry.
Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters with larger size, vacuolated cytoplasm and molding, and are keratin-positive rather than myelomonocytic.
